book.name: Luke
book.title: Luke ka Te Pabe'e Jesus, Te Naa Tooa'a-witu, Numu oo Tuukwena

content: Ewa'yoo umu tumasumudoodu-no kumma'akoosoo numu tuma'emukwadu ka Te Pabe'e yadooadyakwe oo-baa petuse oo nakapunne.
Umu Pharisee nanesootuhibu numu tunedyooedu mee naneyugwedu ka Te Pabe'e nesootzemana mee unakwe, “Oosoo Jesus ka mu tuma'emukwadu pupua'amu-ga'yoo umu-no tukayakwe.”
Soo Te Pabe'e yise meeoo mu natugwengayakwe.
“Tamme puu ka ewow seepu-gana sumuoo nawatsekuse ka mu ewow seepu ka giba-masoo ma'wukese ka sumuoo seepu nawatzekudu watehookakwu.
Ka nawatzekudu seepu mayuse, tamme ka besa soonammena nobe-kwitoo oo tzanogakwu.
Mee yise tamme ka te pupua'amu tuukwekwu, ‘Mu sakwa nu-no besa sokwamapunne, nu ka seepu nawatzekuse oo mayusoo.’

Ka umu Te Naa tutummatzidu mu toha kakasa-ga'yoo puu besa sokwamayakwe ka sumuoo numu tuma'emukwadu nanekwahayakwe, pana mu numu kaaheno meadu mee sukwe naneyugwedu mu toha kakasa-ga'yoo suda oo sokwamakute ka gi kaaheno mu nanekwaha.
Soo mogo'ne puu sumumano (10) ese tupe-ma namadabuedu hee-ga'yoo yise sumuoo watzekuse toogootabuakuse tu nobe-kwitu wutzoo'nekwu oo watena.
Ka oo mayuse besa soonammena mee tu pupua'amu-noko tu nopua'amu tuukwe'e, ‘Nu besa soonamme ka e tuwatzekuna mayuse.’
Ooosoo umu Te Naa tutummatzidu mu toha kakasa-ga'yoo besa sokwamakwu ka sumuoo tuma'emukwadu namayuse ka Te Naa besa podo meno'o meakwu.”
Soo Te Pabe'e yise meeoo natugwe'nga, “Sumu'yoo nana waahoo dooamu-ga'yoo.
Soo oo penage ka tu naa meeoo netamma, ‘U sakwa ka hemma saa'a u ya'ese nuka u hanekukwuna meno'osoo e haneku.’ Soo mu naa yise tu hemmatu oo haneku.
Saa'a yise soo oo tooa ka pumme tu hee-maga-ma tumuse yise kwinga'a-too mea. Ewa nanasuda manena yabesoo ka pumme tu hemma-gana pumatu tu tumupu tzasoo'ow.
Ka saa'a ka tukapu unu natugeno'o, oosoo tsuayina ka tu hemma tzasooase gi hownnekoosoo ka tukapu tumu-wa'ne manepetu.
Sumu'yoo nana oonow tabewa-ga'yoo hogu-ga'yoo oo nedya'we ka tu hogu oo maka tuunguna.
Oosoo ka unu tsuayina ka ‘Umu hogu namakana sakwa nu tuka,’ mee soonamme ka gi hownnekoo ka nadukadu tamamayuna.
Oowetu soohanese mee tusooyugwe, ‘Meno'o nu tsuaya'ega'a. Pana umu e naa tummatzidu puu besa namakayakwe ewa natugapeniyakwe.
Nu sakwa nobe-kwitoo kodyuse ka e naa mee netamma, “Nu tubetse suda u masoonammekute, ka Te Naa tuwazoo.
U sakwa gi e natubangapana, nu ka suta'yoona, u sakwa e sukwe nedya'we.” ’
Oosoo yise nobe-kwitoo kodyuka gisoo pumme oo wupetuga'a soo oo naa ona o kemma o posopedakwudoose tutuha oo poosoopedyase oo-matoo tanomanese, oo masootuhi petuga.
Soo oo tooa yise meeoo oo netamma, ‘Nu tubetse suda mu manuuma ka Te Naa tuwazoo. Mu sakwa gi e natubangapana, nu ka suta'yoona.’
Pana soo oo naa ka umu pumme tummatzidu mee netamma, ‘Yabesoo ka e dooa besa namasooapu hanekuooke, ma'negea'a tuwow, moko pukwi oo namadabuekwuna oo hanekuooke.
Ka unu yoohoopu te tubatsakwuna kootsoo hanehoodooa oo batsahoose oo koomahanekooha. Tamme ewa tukase besa sokwamakwu.
Oosoo ka yoo manepunnena nu ka e dooa watzekutu-kwa'ne mane ka oo petuse tooe nanasuda oo manenumme sapa, nu besa soonamme ka oo petuse. Umu yise ewa tukana too nuka.’
Saa'a soo oo pabe'e oona tubewabe-kwi'yoona kemmana, ka mu tunekwu'u mu nakana,
ka sumuoo umu tu naa tummatzidu-matu meeoo tubenga, ‘How manena umu nugadu-kwa'ne nanaka?’
Soo tutummatzidu yise meeoo oo tuukwe, ‘U wannga'a petuoosesoo, u naa ka unu yoohoopu kootsoo oo batsaku. U naa ka oo-matoo besa soonamme ka oo petuhoosesoo.’
Soo oo pabe'e sutahoose gi ka nobe-kwi eka. Soo oo naa oo-matoo tsebooekese oo too'e ba'e.
Pana oosoo ka tu naa meeoo netamma, ‘Nu tubetse wuna'me ooosapa u nakabetseanumme. Pana u gi hannano'o hemma e geadu. Gi moosooe seepu tooa'a sapa, ewa e pupua'amu-no e tukakwuna e batsakute.
Pana u tooa ka pumme u hemena ka mu sutakoo momoko'ne-matoo sukwe tzasoo'a, meno'o kodyu petuse u yise ka unu yoohoopu kootsoo oo batsakukwu.’
Soo oo naa yise mee oo nanekwegeadooa, ‘U e besaa tooa ooosapa nu-baatu. No'yoona soo nuga hee umetu-kwa'nesoo manepunne.

Besa'yoo te ewa tukana ka besa ta sokwama. Yoo soo manepunne, soo u wannga'a uga nawatsekupu-kwa'ne manese, meno'o yise ka petuse tamme besa sokwama oo-matoo.’ Yooosoo soo Te Naa ka manatooe how tooe te manemose ka te kodyu petuse besa tamme-matoo soonammekwu.”
